patterns.note: Alternating full-width sections with high-contrast background colors (black and vibrant lime green) create distinct visual blocks.
Dramatic typographic contrast is used, pairing oversized, elegant serif headings with clean, legible sans-serif body text for a sophisticated yet modern feel.
The primary color palette consists of a high-contrast black and a vibrant, almost neon, lime green, with white text on dark backgrounds and black text on light backgrounds.
A distinctive wavy graphic acts as a background element, creating a subtle parallax effect as the user scrolls, visually separating content sections with dynamic movement.
Case study sections are introduced with large, numbered indicators and prominent product imagery, establishing a strong visual hierarchy and focus.

technique_notes: The navigation bar remains fixed at the top of the viewport after initial scroll, ensuring persistent access to key site links.

Sections are revealed by the standard vertical scroll of the page content. A unique wavy graphic element in the background scrolls at a different rate than the foreground content, creating a subtle parallax effect to visually separate content blocks. This effect could be achieved using CSS background properties or a JavaScript-driven parallax library, potentially leveraging the detected css-keyframes or webgl-three for more complex motion.

Typographic hierarchy is established through a significant size and weight difference between a sophisticated serif display font for headlines and a modern sans-serif for body copy, enhancing readability and brand presence.

design_tokens.type_scale: Oversized, elegant serif headings (~3-4x body) with clean, legible sans-serif body text and small uppercase sans-serif labels.
design_tokens.radius: Sharp corners throughout all elements and containers, contributing to a modern and precise aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Generally airy, especially in hero and section titles, with generous vertical spacing between major content blocks, creating a sense of luxury and focus.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold and high-contrast color palette of black and vibrant lime green, combined with a distinctive wavy graphic that acts as a dynamic section divider. This creates a memorable and energetic visual identity that feels both modern and luxurious, moving beyond typical corporate aesthetics.
